items.title: E Kaabo! Ibarapa Land Welcomes Senator Sharafadeen Abiodun Alli
items.summary: Hon. Babatunde Sunday Ogunlade warmly welcomed the Oyo State APC governorship candidate to Ibarapa land and reaffirmed the region’s readiness to support the vision of progress.
items.body:
On behalf of the good people of Eruwa, Lanlate, and the entire Ibarapa East Constituency, Hon. Babatunde Sunday Ogunlade warmly welcomes our esteemed Governorship Candidate, Senator Sharafadeen Abiodun Alli, and the Deputy Governorship Candidate, Hon. Adesoji Adedeji, to Ibarapa land.

Their consultative tour across the constituency carried a strong message of unity, grassroots engagement, and a shared vision for progress in Oyo State.

The delegation was joined by respected APC leaders and candidates including Hon. Aderemi Abass Oseni, Senatorial Candidate for Oyo South, and Hon. Niyi Yusuf, Candidate for Ido/Ibarapa East Federal Constituency. The high-level team held consultative meetings with the royal fathers and traditional councils of Eruwa and Lanlate, the Christian Association of Nigeria (CAN), Muslim communities, artisans, tradesmen, and pensioners.

The warm reception and overwhelming enthusiasm confirm that the people of Ibarapa East are fully aligned with the APC vision for a prosperous, inclusive, and forward-moving Oyo State.

Hon. Babatunde Sunday Ogunlade expressed appreciation to the royal fathers, religious leaders, community heads, and the people of Ibarapa East for their solidarity and commitment. He reaffirmed the importance of people-centered leadership, practical development, and a stronger future for the constituency and the state.

E kaabo si Ibarapa East, Senator!

Signed:
Honourable Babatunde Ogunlade
APC Candidate (OYSHA), Ibarapa East State Constituency
items.imageAlt: Welcome banner for Senator Sharafadeen Abiodun Alli in Ibarapa land
items.source: Office of Hon. Babatunde Sunday Ogunlade

items.title: Hon. Babs Expresses Gratitude to BSO Support Group for Campaign Logistics Boost
items.summary: The campaign organization expressed appreciation to the BSO Support Group for donating 50 street pole banners and campaign ludo games for grassroots mobilization.
items.body:
Hon. Babatunde Sunday Ogunlade and the BABS 2027 Campaign Organization extend heartfelt gratitude to the BSO Support Group, led by Mr. Faremi Sunday (AKA Oluwalogbon), for their donation of 50 street pole banners and campaign ludo games to support grassroots mobilization.

The gesture reflects the energy, commitment, and grassroots support behind the campaign. It also reaffirms the collective determination of supporters to energize the movement and deepen community participation across Ibarapa East and beyond.

The campaign remains committed to transparent leadership, inclusive engagement, and a people-centered approach to public service.
items.imageAlt: BSO Support Group donation of campaign banners and ludo games

items.title: Ibarapa East Stands Firm with Progress!
items.summary: Hon. Babatunde Sunday Ogunlade received the APC governorship and deputy governorship candidates during a high-impact consultative tour across Ibarapa East, with widespread community support and endorsement.
items.body:
Yesterday, I had the honor of receiving our Governorship Candidate, Distinguished Senator Sharafadeen Abiodun Alli, alongside our Deputy Governorship Candidate, Hon. Adesoji Adedeji, during their high-impact consultative tour across Ibarapa East.

The delegation was joined by key APC leaders and candidates in our political journey: Hon. Aderemi Abass Oseni (Senatorial Candidate, Oyo South Senatorial District) and Hon. Niyi Yusuf (Candidate for Ido/Ibarapa East Federal Constituency).

As part of this historic engagement, the high-level team held consultative meetings with His Royal Majesty, Oba Samuel Adebayo Adegbola (Ajobo Olurin I), the Eleruwa of Eruwa, the Traditional Councils of Eruwa and Lanlate, the Christian Association of Nigeria (CAN), Muslim communities, and our valued artisans, tradesmen, and pensioners.

The overwhelming warmth, enthusiasm, and unanimous support from all sectors of our community confirm one thing: Ibarapa East is fully aligned with our vision for a prosperous, inclusive, and forward-moving Oyo State.

Thank you to our royal fathers, religious leaders, community heads, and the amazing people of Ibarapa East for coming out in grand style. Together, victory is assured.

E kaabo si Ibarapa East, Senator!

Signed:
Honourable Babatunde Ogunlade
APC Candidate (OYSHA), Ibarapa East State Constituency
items.imageAlt: Hon. Babatunde Sunday Ogunlade and the APC delegation during a consultative visit to Ibarapa East
items.source: Office of Hon. Babatunde Sunday Ogunlade

items.title: World Teachers’ Day Message
items.summary: BABS Media extends appreciation to teachers and education personnel serving Ibarapa East.
items.body:
On World Teachers’ Day, Hon. Babatunde Sunday Ogunlade (BABS), through BABS Media, recognises teachers across Ibarapa East, including SUBEB and TESCOM staff. Teachers help shape knowledge, character and opportunity, and their work contributes to the development of students and communities. The message wishes all teachers greater recognition, fulfilment and support in their service.

Signed: BABS Media — 5 October 2026

items.title: Nigeria at 66: Independence Day Message
items.summary: A message marking Nigeria’s 66th Independence Anniversary with goodwill for peace, unity and sustainable development.
items.body:
BABS Media, on behalf of Hon. Babatunde Sunday Ogunlade, extends Independence Day greetings to Nigerians at home and abroad. The message reflects on the country’s resilience and diversity and offers prayers for peace, responsible leadership and sustainable development.

Residents of Eruwa, Lanlate and surrounding communities are wished peace and prosperity. The message encourages unity, peaceful civic participation and a shared commitment to community progress.

Signed: BABS Media — 1 October 2026

items.title: Ward Tour and Empowerment Programme Concludes in Ward 02, Eruwa
items.summary: The final ward-tour engagement took place at Anwaru-Islam School, Anko, Eruwa, with an empowerment programme for widows, older residents and other vulnerable people.
items.body:
The grand finale of BABS’ Ward Tour and Empowerment Programme took place on Sunday, 27 September 2026, at Anwaru-Islam School, Anko, Eruwa, Ward 02. The programme focused on community engagement and support for widows, older residents and other vulnerable members of the community. The media team described the event as an opportunity to hear residents’ concerns and continue dialogue across Ibarapa East.

Signed: BABS Media — 27 September 2026

items.title: Ward Tour Programme: September 2026
items.summary: A notice outlined planned ward-tour engagements across Ibarapa East from 20 to 27 September 2026.
items.body:
BABS Media announced a ward-tour and empowerment programme planned for 20–27 September 2026 across communities in Ibarapa East. The notice described the engagements as opportunities to meet residents, listen to concerns and extend support to widows, older people and other vulnerable members of society. Venue and time details were to be confirmed for each ward through the media team.

Signed: BABS Media — 18 September 2026

items.title: BABS Media Announces Ward Tour Across Ibarapa East
items.summary: The media team announced a ward tour planned for 20–27 September 2026, with community engagement and an empowerment programme as stated objectives.
items.body:
BABS Media announced that Hon. Babatunde Sunday Ogunlade planned to visit wards and communities across Ibarapa East from 20 to 27 September 2026. The notice said the tour would create opportunities for direct interaction, listening to residents’ concerns and extending support to widows, older residents and other vulnerable members of the community.

The programme notice framed the tour as an opportunity for dialogue and community participation. It is retained as a historical announcement.

Signed: BABS Media Team — 18 September 2026
